_comment: Elongated octahedron diamond cut: top apex + upper ring + lower ring + bottom apex. Composition of 3 stacked CylinderMesh frustums with radial_segments=4 (gem-faceted square cross-section). Cone 1 = top pyramid (apex up). Frustum = middle band (taper down). Cone 2 = bottom pyramid (apex down).

components._part: top pyramid (apex at y=0.6, base at y=0.1)
middle band (frustum from upper ring 0.354 down to lower ring 0.212)
bottom pyramid (top ring 0.212 at y=-0.1, apex at y=-0.4)
